children: Immunome amended its 2017 license with Bristol-Myers Squibb, acquiring full patent rights to varegacestat (formerly AL102) and AL101 and removing all future milestone and royalty obligations. As consideration, Immunome paid $20.0 million in cash and issued 4,425,487 common shares. In a concurrent Stock Issuance Agreement, Immunome agreed to register the shares for resale, targeting an SEC filing by November 16, 2026. The moves consolidate program ownership and simplify future economics for the company.
